derived_variables.description: Optional dataset variables computed by the host from other dataset variables by a fixed-grammar arithmetic expression (measurement-model.md section 8, M15; S19). The pattern bounds only the character surface; token formation, balanced parentheses, nesting (max 32) and expression length (max 256) are enforced by the semantic checks, pinned by examples/derivation-vectors.json.

invoke.description: Required for every advertised verb. A timeout after dispatch may have an unknown outcome. Idempotent is an eligibility claim, not permission for automatic retries.

title: OTDP 0.2.1 device descriptor — STG architecture contract
description: OTDP 0.2.1 device and class declarations. Read core specification, measurement-model.md, device-classes.md and the pinned profile catalog. Schema validation is followed by class/action/constraint and dataset semantic checks.

operationPolicy.description: Required for every advertised verb. A timeout after dispatch may have an unknown outcome. Idempotent is an eligibility claim, not permission for automatic retries.

adapter.description: Trusted reviewed Python plugin. entry_point names a zero-argument factory. Dependencies require exact released versions; no unreviewed dynamic installation.

codec.description: SCPI scalar codec. enum_map maps logical enum values to wire tokens; reverse mapping must be unique. Numeric parsing is finite ASCII decimal; exact rules in spec §6.

binaryBinding.description: Read-only passive CAN integer codec in this revision. Sub-byte fields require one byte and must fit within it; cross-field rules in spec §10.

feature_id.description: The provider feature this integration requires, in the required_features pattern. It must also appear in required_features (S04) and the host must have admitted the pinned contract.

provider.description: Pinned transport-provider contract (otdp-transport-provider.schema.json). id/path/sha256 is the contracts item shape verbatim: package-relative, digest-pinned, resolved inside the admitted bundle after symlink resolution. The pin names the bytes that were reviewed; the host operator's admission of the contract grants authority.

customTransport.description: connection_key resolves to a commissioned, scoped host transport. Addresses/paths/credentials are not granted by this descriptor. When provider is present, the connection is backed by that admitted transport-provider contract; when absent, the integration is honestly incomplete for this device.
